_comment: Post-publish validation manifest. Defines expected custom fields per entity after a successful Acumatica customization publish. Used by validate-publish.py to verify fields exist in live API responses.

_skipped_fields: UsrComplianceHoldReason — DAC + SQL exist but not yet visible in REST API $adHocSchema. Re-enable after confirming fields appear.
UsrBoxLabelPrinted — server-side idempotency flag for Device Hub auto-print; not surfaced via REST API adHocSchema. Validate via sql_columns only.

UsrFRPickStatus — Kensium WMS pick-status field (read-only from Heritage side); accessed via late-bound PXCache.GetValue to avoid hard compile-time dependency on the Kensium assembly. Not a Heritage custom field — do not validate.

_notes.UsrDisablePayLink: CustomerExt : PXCacheExtension<Customer> field. Works on AR303000 screen and in C# (ARInvoiceEntry_PayLink_Extension), but NOT exposed via REST API $adHocSchema for Customer entity. SQL column on BAccount table. Cannot validate via REST API schema check — only via sql_columns.
_notes.UsrBoxLabelPrinted: SOShipmentLabelExt : PXCacheExtension<SOShipment> field. Idempotency guard for Device Hub box-label auto-print (SOShipmentEntry_LabelAutoPrint). Set to true after all SMPrintJob records queued for every SOPackageDetailEx on the shipment. Reset to false if shipment status leaves Confirmed ('N'). Not surfaced via REST API — validate via sql_columns only.
_notes.UsrContainerRef: POOrderExt : PXCacheExtension<POOrder> field. Container / BOL reference string (nvarchar 50) on PO301000 header form. Displayed as a free-text edit field. Surfaced via REST API custom.Document block — validated in PurchaseOrder custom_fields above.
_notes.UsrWMSStatus: SOOrderExt : PXCacheExtension<SOOrder> field. Read-only WMS pick-status drop-down on SO301000 (Not Started / Allocated / Picking / Finishing / Packed / Shipped). Set by the Kensium WMS integration. SQL column on SOOrder table. Not currently surfaced via the REST API $adHocSchema endpoint — validate via sql_columns only.
_notes.UsrComplianceHold: SOOrderExt : PXCacheExtension<SOOrder> bool field. Compliance-hold flag set programmatically (not user-editable). Triggers a warning banner and disables shipment creation on SO301000 when true. DAC + SQL exist but not yet visible in the REST API $adHocSchema response — re-enable in SalesOrder.custom_fields once confirmed.
_notes.UsrComplianceHoldReason: SOOrderExt : PXCacheExtension<SOOrder> string field (nvarchar 500). Human-readable reason text accompanying UsrComplianceHold. Same REST API visibility caveat as UsrComplianceHold — validate via sql_columns only until confirmed in $adHocSchema.
